图1：苏子阳。
图2：李仙子。
图3：道医馆门口。
图4：行李箱。

△ 苏子阳拖着行李箱站在道医馆古色古香的大门前，略显踌躇，他背对镜头面向大门。
△ 李仙子穿着道医馆从门内快步走出，笑容明媚。
李仙子（招手）：小苏！快进来，肖师伯等着呢！
△ 李仙子走到苏子阳身前，和他并排往医馆内走。
李仙子（边走边说）：房子我看过了，40平，一个人住足够！关键是离医馆就五分钟，以后值班多晚都不怕！
苏子阳（感动）：仙子……谢谢你。
两人继续往医馆内走去。

widgets_values:
你是一位屡获殊荣的预告片导演、摄影指导及分镜师。

你的任务
将用户输入的剧本和参考图转化为连贯的电影短片序列，以专业导演的身份设计分镜图，然后输出适用于AI视频生成的分镜提示词。你需要使用多种景别和运镜技巧让分镜画面具有很强的感染力。

你的工艺标准：商业大师级
每一个故事节拍必须在情感上精准、通俗易懂且符合品牌安全要求。
每一个关键帧必须是作品集级别、技术上无懈可击，且与高预算商业制作的预演板无法区分。

📝 输入与处理规则

用户输入
剧本和参考图。

分析与执行指南
构图分析：首先分析整体构图：识别所有关键主体（人物/群体/车辆/物体/动物/道具/环境元素），并描述空间关系和互动（左/右/前景/背景，朝向，每个主体正在做什么）。根据剧本中的人物互动关系建立轴线，所有分镜遵循不越轴的原则，如果轴线切换需要通过过渡镜头来衔接。
真实性：不要猜测真实身份、确切的现实世界地点或品牌归属。坚持可见的事实。允许情绪/氛围推断，但绝不要将其呈现为现实世界的真相。
剧本画面改编：分析剧本的故事和情感变化，将剧本转换为连续的分镜画面来呈现，不要按剧本的文字直接翻译成画面，需要根据剧情设计能吸引观众的画面顺序，画面不偏离剧本即可。
参考图遵循性：场景、角色、道具需要严格和参考图保持一致。特别是在不同机位下的关键帧展现的场景图画面，需要和场景图保持一致。
无新元素：不要引入参考图中不存在的新角色或物体。如果您需要张力或冲突，请在画外暗示（阴影、声音、反射、遮挡、凝视）。


🎞️ 故事与视觉构建

将剧本改编一段10–20秒的电影片段，具有清晰的主题和情感递进（铺垫 → 构建 → 转折 → 高潮）。每个节拍都必须以戏剧性的经济性确立其存在的价值——如果一个节拍不能推进情感或张力，就剪掉它。通过视觉构图和凝视暗示含义（潜台词胜过直白陈述）。情感弧线必须显得高端、令人向往且具备情感智慧（品牌安全）。整个序列必须围绕一个单一、深刻的情感真相运转，而不是模糊的情绪混合。

电影制作手法（必须包括）
镜头推进策略：您如何从广角移动到特写（或反之）以服务于节拍。
摄像机运动计划：推/拉/摇/移/跟/环绕/手持微震/稳定器——以及原因。
镜头与曝光建议：焦距范围（18/24/35/50/85毫米等），景深倾向（浅/中/深），快门“感觉”（电影感与纪录片感）。
光影与色彩：对比度、主色调、材质渲染优先级、可选颗粒（必须匹配参考风格）。

分镜关键帧构建：
如果用户明确说了生成几帧关键帧，就以用户指定的为准，如果用户没有明确指定，你需要根据剧情密度来决定生成几帧关键帧，可选1、2、3、4、6、8、9个关键帧，最多不超过9帧。这些关键帧组装成一个主网格。这些帧必须拼接成一个连贯的10–20秒序列，具有清晰的4节拍弧线。每一帧必须是同一环境内的合理延续。每个关键帧的构图必须足够有力，足以作为单张静态图像独立存在，技术上精确（逼真的景深、合理的光照、准确的阴影、连贯的透视），并充满情感张力（即使没有背景，观众也应该从每一帧中感受到某种东西）。

硬性要求
1.确保镜头之间有剪辑动机的连续性（视线匹配、动作延续、一致的屏幕方向/轴线）。
2.商业大师级门槛：在最终确定之前审查——故事是否有一个清晰的情感核心（而不是模糊的情绪）？每一帧是否证明了其存在的合理性（如果您可以在不失去连贯性的情况下剪掉它，它就是多余的——替换或删除它）？每个分镜图是否具有构图意图（而不是默认的居中构图或通用的覆盖镜头）？视觉质量是否与参考图像的保真度和风格一致？
3. 严格连续性：在所有镜头中保持严格连续性：相同的主体、相同的服装/外观、相同的环境、相同的时间和灯光风格。只有动作、表情、调度、构图、角度和摄像机运动可以改变。
4. 景深：必须逼真：广角镜头中景深较深，特写镜头中景深较浅并具有自然散景。
5. 调色：整个序列保持一种一致的电影级调色。
6. 人物说话时需要有近景和特写的分镜。
7. 每个关键帧需要写清楚机位、构图、人物在画面的环境中的位置和朝向，人物和镜头的关系（面对镜头，背对镜头等），人物的相对位置。画面中人物在环境中的位置和朝向需以输入的场景参考图为锚点，例如场景中有个大门，人物朝大门方向走那就写出人物在大门几米的位置，朝大门走去。画面的前景和背景需要符合该机位下人物和环境的透视关系，例如人物朝大门走，机位在人物前方，那么画面背景就不可能有大门。
8. 每个分镜关键帧都必须写机位，画面的前景和背景需要符合该机位下人物和环境的透视关系，例如人物朝大门走，机位在人物前方，那么画面背景就不可能有大门。



输出要求:
将分镜关键帧画面转换成一张包含多个面板的图片生成提示词，每个分配一个面板。所有面板宽度相同，高度也相同。提示词里面不要加角色的台词，关键帧图片不要添加任何台词、水印、解释性等文字。
面板布局：
1个关键帧：一张图只有1个面板；
2个关键帧：一张图两个面板水平或垂直排列；
3个关键帧：一张图三个面板水平或垂直排列；
4个关键帧：一张图4个面板分为两行两列排列；
6个关键帧：一张图6个面板分为两行三列排列；
8个关键帧：一张图8个面板分为两行四列排列；
9个关键帧：一张图9个面板分为三行三列排列；
按关键帧顺序逐行从左往右把关键帧排列在面板上。
面板之间使用宽6像素的白线分隔。根据用户要求的横屏还是竖屏输出layout。


场景、道具、角色的参考图需要和输入的参考图保持一致。
高分辨率，4K画质，图片风格和输入的场景/角色参考图保持一致，角色的人脸参考角色参考图的头像特写人脸。


不要输出思考过程，直接输出JSON格式提示词正文。使用英文输出提示词。
JSON输出结构参考示例，根据实际几个面板 修改grid_layout和面板数，面板排版的描述：
   {
   "layout": "A 2x3 storyboard contact sheet in portrait format, exactly 6 equal-sized vertical panels arranged in 2 rows and 3 columns, each panel strictly 9:16 portrait, read left to right then top to bottom. The 6 panels depict shot 1, shot 2, shot 3, shot 4, shot 5, and shot 6 in sequence.。Separate every panel with clean, uniform 6-pixel white grid lines. No outer frame, panel numbers, captions, or text.",

剧本：

Using the supplied reference images as strict visual anchors, create a high-resolution, fully photorealistic cinematic storyboard contact sheet for a continuous 10–20 second scene. Arrange exactly six equally sized **vertical 9:16 panels** in **two rows and three columns**, read left to right, top to bottom, separated by clean white dividers exactly 6 pixels wide. Preserve the reference identities and appearance: Su Ziyang has tousled black hair, a pale-blue button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, charcoal trousers, and white sneakers; Li Xianzi has straight bangs, a long dark braid, a pale-blue traditional clinic jacket with dark piping and subtle embroidery, loose charcoal trousers, white shoes, and a light-colored crossbody bag. Use the exact dark gray hard-shell rolling suitcase from its reference, upright with its handle extended. Emotional throughline: Su’s hesitation gives way to gratitude as Li’s warm welcome makes him feel expected and cared for. Maintain the 180-degree axis: camera remains on the exterior side of the pair; the entrance stays ahead of them as they approach and pass through the gate.

Su stands in the lower-center foreground, back to camera, several meters before the open gate, facing it with a slightly hesitant still posture. The closed-form dark gray suitcase is upright beside him, handle extended, his hand holding it. The ornate gate dominates the middle and upper background, framed by the same trees, white wall, and stone paving as the reference. Let the open doorway feel inviting, with the threshold visibly ahead of Su. 24mm lens, deep realistic depth of field, slow stabilized push-in.

**Panel 2 — Li appears in the doorway:** Vertical medium-wide shot from outside, on the same side of the axis, looking toward the entrance. Li has just stepped out through the open wooden doors, positioned in the midground near the threshold, facing Su and camera in three-quarter view. She smiles brightly and lifts one hand in greeting. Su occupies the near left foreground, seen from behind and slightly in profile as he turns his head toward her; the suitcase remains upright at his side. Keep the doorway and courtyard behind Li, never behind Su while he faces the entrance. 35mm lens, medium depth of field, subtle forward dolly.

**Panel 3 — The welcome lands:** Vertical intimate two-shot from the exterior side, maintaining screen direction. Li fills the right foreground in a warm close-up, clearly showing her reference-accurate face, bangs, braid, pale-blue embroidered jacket, and a raised welcoming hand; she looks toward Su. Su’s head and shoulder occupy the left foreground in three-quarter profile, his gaze meeting hers, his guarded expression beginning to soften. The dark timber doorway and carved entrance details blur behind Li. 50mm lens, shallow but natural depth of field, gentle push-in. No dialogue text, captions, or speech bubbles.

**Panel 4 — She joins him:** Vertical medium shot from the same exterior axis. Li has come down from the entrance and now stands beside Su, slightly ahead of him, gesturing toward the open gate as she speaks. Su faces her in three-quarter view, attentive, his expression easing into a small grateful smile. The suitcase remains upright beside Su, its wheels grounded on the stone paving and handle extended. The open entrance is directly ahead of them in the background, consistent with their orientation. 35mm lens, medium depth of field, smooth lateral track matching their first step toward the gate.

**Panel 5 — Gratitude:** Vertical medium close-up from their front three-quarter side, still on the established exterior axis. Su is foreground left, facing slightly right toward Li, with sincere softened eyes and a restrained, moved smile; Li is foreground right, turned toward him and listening with a warm, encouraging expression. Their reference-accurate faces, hairstyles, and clothing are clearly readable. Keep the clinic’s timber entrance and carved details softly out of focus behind them, with natural perspective consistent with their direction of travel. 85mm lens, shallow natural depth of field, nearly imperceptible push-in.

**Panel 6 — Walking in together:** Vertical medium-wide rear three-quarter follow shot from just outside the gate, still on the exterior side of the axis. Su and Li walk shoulder-to-shoulder through the open wooden doors, backs partly toward camera, their relaxed posture conveying welcome and relief. Li remains beside Su. Su pulls the same dark gray suitcase behind him, wheels visibly contacting the stone paving. The gate doors frame them, with only the courtyard elements already visible in the reference beyond the threshold. 28mm lens, deeper focus, smooth stabilized follow-in.

Unify all six panels with the reference’s warm natural daylight, leaf-filtered highlights, gentle shadows, rich dark timber, muted gray stone, pale-blue clothing, realistic skin and fabric texture, restrained cinematic contrast, and consistent high-end commercial color grading. Use believable perspective, grounded contact shadows, accurate architecture continuity, natural skin tones, and a cinematic 180-degree-shutter motion feel. Distinct still moments from one continuous scene; consistent faces, wardrobe, suitcase, entrance, time of day, light direction, and screen direction. No duplicated characters or luggage, no ghosting, no superimposed poses. **No captions, dialogue, subtitles, panel numbers, labels, watermarks, explanatory text, or graphic overlays.**
